findings.title: Delete-cache success never refreshes cache status
findings.body: deleteCacheMutation onSuccess in CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx only shows a toast and calls onSuccess?.(), unlike disconnectMutation which invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars and viewer.apps.integrations in onSettled. The connectedCalendars query provides cacheUpdatedAt, so after deleting the cache the dropdown will keep showing the old Last updated timestamp until a manual refetch. Invalidate the connectedCalendars query on delete success/settled.

findings.title: Cache status includes expired rows
findings.body: getCacheStatusByCredentialIds() in calendar-cache.repository.ts groups all CalendarCache rows by credentialId with no expiresAt filter, while getCachedAvailability() explicitly ignores rows with expiresAt < now. The UI therefore shows Cache Status / Last updated even when every cache row is expired and will never be used, and deleting only expired data looks broken. Filter to expiresAt >= now, consistent with reads.

findings.title: Empty updateMany to bump updatedAt is wasteful and may fail
findings.body: fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache() in CalendarService.ts calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) after every cache population. Passing empty data relies on implicit @updatedAt handling that Prisma updateMany with {} does not guarantee and can reject as empty data, and on success it rewrites every SelectedCalendar row for the credential on every cache refresh just to touch a timestamp the frontend does not even read (frontend uses CalendarCache.updatedAt). Remove this write or set an explicit field.

findings.title: Throws generic Error instead of TRPCError
findings.body: deleteCacheHandler in deleteCache.handler.ts throws new Error("Credential not found or access denied") when the credential does not belong to the caller. A plain Error surfaces as an internal server error instead of NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN, leaking no useful status to the client and conflating not-found with forbidden. Throw a TRPCError with the appropriate code.

findings.title: Unfiltered credentialIds passed to cache status query
findings.body: connectedCalendars.handler.ts builds credentialIds by mapping every connectedCalendar without filtering null/undefined values or non-Google credentials and calls getCacheStatusByCredentialIds() unconditionally, even when the list is empty. Null credentialIds will fail Prisma validation for an Int filter, and the query runs for Outlook and other integrations that never have CalendarCache rows. Filter to defined Google credentialIds and skip the query when empty.

findings.title: BSD-only sed breaks on Linux
findings.body: test-gcal-webhooks.sh uses sed -i '' -E to rewrite GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL. The empty backup-suffix form is BSD/macOS syntax; GNU sed on Linux treats '' as a script and fails, so the helper script cannot update the env file on Linux. Use a portable sed invocation or a non-sed rewrite.

findings.title: Cache timestamp hardcoded to en-US
findings.body: CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx formats cacheUpdatedAt with new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...) regardless of the user's locale from useLocale(). Users in other locales see a foreign date format for Last updated. Pass the active locale to the formatter.
